text:
Rae (Docs): Product wants a short, pragmatic migration note for v1 -> v2 (invoke -> generate). Ask: 1-pager, tiny code snippets (cURL/JS/Python), support triage bullets, and an ops checklist. Can we hit EOW?

Eli (API): Yes. Short list of breaking changes: `model_id` renamed to `model`; single-string `input` replaced by `messages` array of {role,content}; streaming event key `token` -> `delta` and shape slightly different. We added an opt-in compat header `X-Compat-Mode: v1` to ease transition.

Rae (Docs): Can you drop minimal before/after cURL and a tiny server shim we can paste? Keep examples tiny.

Eli (API): Old v1 curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-std","input":"Explain recursion"}'
```
New v2 curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-std-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain recursion"}]}'
```
Tiny JS shim (server):
```js
function shimLegacy(body){ if(body.model_id) return { model: body.model_id+'-2', messages:[{role:'user', content: body.input||''}]}; return body }
```

Noah (SDK): I'll add an example to the JS SDK changelog showing param rename and a helper wrapper. Expect PR by EOD.

Zara (SE): For Dedicated/on-prem customers: call out path change to `/v2/*` and include a short NGINX snippet to route a canary to v2 (10% -> 100%). Also remind them to update firewall rules.

Becky (Support): Triage bullets I'll paste in doc: 1) If POST returns 410, ask if customer uses pinned SDK/private deploy. 2) Suggest temporary `X-Compat-Mode: v1` header. 3) If streaming client breaks, check for `token` -> `delta` mapping and offer to enable compat for 2 weeks. I'll prep canned replies.

Rae (Docs): Good — include a short "What breaks" FAQ entry listing likely client changes (payload, streaming, small perf hit using compat shim).

Eli (API): Perf note: compat shim adds ~5-12ms median in our benchmarks; include that under "Performance impact." Also: GETs will receive 307 redirects in Stage 2, POSTs without compat header will receive 410 in Stage 3. We keep redirects for 6 weeks; hard sunset at 8 weeks.

Noah (SDK): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/129 — adds migration helpers and examples.

Rae (Docs): Draft PR for the doc: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3257 (v1-to-v2-migration-short). Please review wording: Eli for API bits, Zara for ops, Becky for support copy.

Zara (SE): NGINX canary snippet: `map $request_uri $to_v2 { default 0; ~^/v2/ 1;} split_clients \"$remote_addr\" $bucket { 10% v2; * v1; }` — paste into Dedicated section. Also call out SSL passthrough caveat.

Becky (Support): Canned reply (short): "We recommend adding header X-Compat-Mode: v1 as a short-term workaround. We'll help schedule a migration call for long-running/volume customers"

Rae (Docs): Leaving a short CS playbook with steps: detect (logs/metric), advise header/shim, schedule migration, remove compat after window. Add a copyable Datadog query for impacted paths.

Eli (API): Quick Datadog log query to paste: `logs(\"service:api AND path:/v1/invoke\").rollup(\"count\").by(\"host\")` — customers can adapt.

DocsBot: PR created -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3257 (draft).

Rae (Docs): Timeline: reviewers by Thu EOD so we can publish Fri AM with soft in-app banner. If anyone needs more time ping me here.

Noah (SDK): Reviewing now. I can also add a small compatibility function to the polyfill package so clients can upgrade with minimal changes.

Zara (SE): Will review ops language and add a Dedicated checklist tomorrow.

Becky (Support): Will add canned messages and escalation steps once PR is merged.

Rae (Docs): Thanks all — I'll merge after approvals and coordinate the announcement schedule with Product.
